_comment: Synthetic fares. The Advance/Off-Peak/Anytime contrast is deliberate: Advance is cheap and rigid, Anytime is expensive and fully flexible. That contrast is what makes the policy conversation in the demo meaningful. Prices are the undiscounted adult single; railcard discount is applied by the get_fares tool.

railcards._comment: Public fare reference data, not traveller PII. The Journey Search server uses this to price a discount once the Planner has learned WHICH railcard the traveller holds from the shared Traveller Profile server. discount_percent must stay in step with fixtures/travellers.json.

TTG.name: Two Together Railcard
TTG.restriction: Not valid before 09:30 Mon-Fri on Off-Peak and Anytime fares. Advance fares are unrestricted.

YNG.name: 16-25 Railcard
YNG.restriction: Minimum fare applies to Anytime tickets before 10:00 Mon-Fri.

SRN.name: Senior Railcard
SRN.restriction: Not valid on Anytime fares before 09:30 Mon-Fri.

FAM.name: Family and Friends Railcard
FAM.restriction: No time restriction. At least one adult and one child must travel together.

EUS-MAN.conditions: Valid only on the booked service. No changes, no refunds.
Valid on off-peak services. Changes and refunds permitted; 10 GBP administration fee applies.
Valid on any service. Fully flexible, fully refundable, no fee.
